headline: HOMEBODY gets the speed dial
lede: The lot now runs at YOUR pace: pause, normal, fast, fastest — keys 1-4, comma/period, or tappable gold pips in the panel. The clock that bossed everyone around now takes orders, The Sims 2000 style.

notes.text: HOMEBODY #2227: a four-gear speed dial (pause/normal/x2/x4) rides the sim state and the replay hash; digits set it outside buy mode, the pips answer taps on phones, and the attract demo hurries the morning chores to teach it. peoplecheck 330/330, drive 61/61, two mutants caught red.

The warden's idle-kick aimed this slot at #2222 while its author was mid-merge — the TARGET was already shipped minutes in. Verified against the board before resuming, then ran the never-dry ladder to a fresh gap instead of doubling work.

Prod verification has two false-red traps: jalfern.com's edge held a stale page ~35 min after a SUCCESS deployment (the deployments API is the honest mid-window answer), and lazy chunks carry assorted names — a marker sweep must scan all assets, not just index-*.
